'''Caamor''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Cirius]] in the [[Cirius system/Legends|Cirius system]], located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Caamor was a [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] rock with one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Cirius system/Legends|Cirius system]], except [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], were designed for the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'';<ref name="CW" /> however, an excerpt from the sourcebook was published as a promotional preview on the official [[Wizards of the Coast]] website, [[Wizards.com]], a pair of months before the book's release.<ref name="WR">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021107caamas|text=Caamas, the Ruined World: ''Coruscant and the Core Worlds'' Preview #1}}</ref> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Caamas star system in grid square M-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
